info.title: unicortex
info.description: Control Unity Editor from the terminal via UniCortex.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new empty AnimationClip (.anim file).

options.name: --loop
options.description: Enable Loop Time. (Optional)

options.name: --frame-rate
options.description: Sample rate in frames per second. (Default: 60)

commands.name: list
commands.description: List settings and all float curves (with keys) of an AnimationClip as JSON.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove one float curve from an AnimationClip.

options.name: --animator-relative-path
options.description: Path relative to the Animator root. Empty for the root. (Default: @"")

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set one float curve of an AnimationClip, replacing all of its keys.

options.name: --animator-relative-path
options.description: Path relative to the Animator root (e.g. "Root/Child"). Empty for the root. (Default: @"")

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Refresh the Unity Asset Database.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a component to a GameObject.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List serialized properties of a component on a GameObject.

options.name: --component-index
options.description: Index when multiple components of the same type exist. (Default: 0)

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set a serialized property on a component.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a component from a GameObject.

options.name: --component-index
options.description: Index when multiple components of the same type exist. (Default: 0)

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clear all console logs in the Unity Editor.

commands.name: logs
commands.description: Get console log entries from the Unity Editor. All levels are included unless --info, --warning, or --error is given.

options.name: --count
options.description: Number of log entries to retrieve. (Default: null)

options.name: --stack-trace
options.description: Include stack traces in the output. (Optional)

options.name: --info
options.description: Include info-level entries (Debug.Log). (Optional)

options.name: --warning
options.description: Include warning-level entries. (Optional)

options.name: --error
options.description: Include error-level entries. (Optional)

commands.name: pause
commands.description: Pause the Unity Editor. Use with step for frame-by-frame control.

commands.name: ping
commands.description: Check connectivity with the Unity Editor.

commands.name: play
commands.description: Start Play Mode in the Unity Editor.

commands.name: redo
commands.description: Perform Redo in the Unity Editor.

commands.name: reload-domain
commands.description: Request a domain reload (script recompilation) in the Unity Editor.

commands.name: save
commands.description: Save the currently active stage in the Unity Editor (Scene, Prefab, or Timeline).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Get the current state of the Unity Editor (play mode, paused). Works even when the editor is paused.

commands.name: step
commands.description: Advance the Unity Editor by one frame while paused.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop Play Mode in the Unity Editor.

commands.name: undo
commands.description: Perform Undo in the Unity Editor.

commands.name: unpause
commands.description: Unpause the Unity Editor. Works even when the editor is paused.

commands.name: execute
commands.description: Execute an extension by name.

options.name: --arguments
options.description: (Default: null)

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all extensions registered in the Unity Editor.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new empty GameObject in the current scene.

options.name: --parent-instance-id
options.description: Instance ID of the parent GameObject. If omitted, created at the scene root. (Default: null)

options.name: --sibling-index
options.description: Position among siblings (0 = first). If omitted, placed last. (Default: null)

options.name: --use-rect-transform
options.description: Create with a RectTransform for UI. Automatic when the parent has a RectTransform. (Optional)

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a GameObject from the current scene by its instance ID.

commands.name: duplicate
commands.description: Duplicate a GameObject, deep-copying its children and components.

options.name: --name
options.description: Optional name for the duplicate. If omitted, a Unity-style unique name like "Foo (1)" is assigned. (Default: null)

commands.name: find
commands.description: Find GameObjects in every loaded scene.

commands.name: modify
commands.description: Modify a GameObject's properties.

options.name: --name
options.description: New name for the GameObject. (Default: null)

options.name: --activate
options.description: Set the GameObject active. Cannot be combined with --deactivate. (Optional)

options.name: --deactivate
options.description: Set the GameObject inactive. Cannot be combined with --activate. (Optional)

options.name: --tag
options.description: Tag to assign to the GameObject. (Default: null)

options.name: --layer
options.description: Layer number to assign to the GameObject. (Default: null)

options.name: --parent-instance-id
options.description: Instance ID of the new parent GameObject. Use 0 to move to root. (Default: null)

options.name: --sibling-index
options.description: New position among siblings (0 = first). (Default: null)

options.name: --keep-local-transform
options.description: When changing the parent, keep the local transform instead of the world transform. (Optional)

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Capture the Game View as a PNG file. Only available in Play Mode.

commands.name: focus
commands.description: Switch focus to the Game View window.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Get the current Game View scale (zoom factor) and its valid range.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set the Game View scale (zoom factor). The value is clamped to the valid range.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Get the current Game View size (width and height in pixels).

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all available Game View sizes (built-in and custom).

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set the Game View resolution by index from the size list.

commands.name: press
commands.description: Press keys of the keyboard via Input System in Play Mode: press all the keys in the same frame, keep them pressed for --hold-duration seconds, and release them. Requires com.unity.inputsystem.

options.name: --hold-duration
options.description: Seconds to keep the keys pressed before releasing them (default 0: release in the next frame). (Default: null)

commands.name: click
commands.description: Click (or tap) at a position: press, keep it pressed for --hold-duration seconds, and release. Simulates the Input System Mouse device in Play Mode. Requires com.unity.inputsystem. Specify either --x and --y, or --instance-id (requires com.unity.ugui).

options.name: --x
options.description: X coordinate in screen pixels (Screen.width space). Origin (0,0) is at the bottom-left of the Game View. Increases to the right. Note: capture_game_view images are at the Game View resolution with a top-left origin, so a pixel (px, py) in the image corresponds to x = px, y = imageHeight - py. (Default: null)

options.name: --y
options.description: Y coordinate in screen pixels (Screen.height space). Origin (0,0) is at the bottom-left of the Game View. Increases upward. This is the inverse of typical image coordinates where Y increases downward. (Default: null)

options.name: --instance-id
options.description: instanceId of the UI GameObject. Its center is used. (Default: null)

options.name: --button
options.description: Mouse button: "left" (default), "right", or "middle". (Default: @"left")

options.name: --hold-duration
options.description: Seconds to keep the button pressed before releasing it, e.g. for a long press (default 0: release in the next frame). (Default: null)

commands.name: drag
commands.description: Drag (or swipe) in one call: press at the start, move to the end over --duration seconds (at most one move per frame), and release. Simulates the Input System Mouse device in Play Mode. Requires com.unity.inputsystem. Specify the start with --from-x and --from-y, or --from-instance-id (requires com.unity.ugui), and the end with --to-x and --to-y, or --to-instance-id.

options.name: --from-x
options.description: Start X coordinate of the drag in screen pixels (Screen.width space). Origin (0,0) is at the bottom-left of the Game View. Increases to the right. Note: capture_game_view images are at the Game View resolution with a top-left origin, so a pixel (px, py) in the image corresponds to x = px, y = imageHeight - py. Must be given together with --from-y. (Default: null)

options.name: --from-y
options.description: Start Y coordinate of the drag in screen pixels (Screen.height space). Origin (0,0) is at the bottom-left of the Game View. Increases upward. Must be given together with --from-x. (Default: null)

options.name: --from-instance-id
options.description: instanceId of the UI GameObject whose center is the start of the drag. (Default: null)

options.name: --to-x
options.description: End X coordinate of the drag. Must be given together with --to-y. (Default: null)

options.name: --to-y
options.description: End Y coordinate of the drag. Must be given together with --to-x. (Default: null)

options.name: --to-instance-id
options.description: instanceId of the UI GameObject whose center is the end of the drag. (Default: null)

options.name: --button
options.description: Mouse button: "left" (default), "right", or "middle". (Default: @"left")

options.name: --duration
options.description: Seconds to move from the start to the end (default 0.2). (Default: null)

commands.name: move
commands.description: Move the mouse to a position without pressing a button, e.g. for hover. Simulates the Input System Mouse device in Play Mode. Requires com.unity.inputsystem. Specify either --x and --y, or --instance-id (requires com.unity.ugui).

options.name: --x
options.description: X coordinate in screen pixels (Screen.width space). Origin (0,0) is at the bottom-left of the Game View. Increases to the right. Note: capture_game_view images are at the Game View resolution with a top-left origin, so a pixel (px, py) in the image corresponds to x = px, y = imageHeight - py. (Default: null)

options.name: --y
options.description: Y coordinate in screen pixels (Screen.height space). Origin (0,0) is at the bottom-left of the Game View. Increases upward. This is the inverse of typical image coordinates where Y increases downward. (Default: null)

options.name: --instance-id
options.description: instanceId of the UI GameObject. Its center is used. (Default: null)

commands.name: targets
commands.description: List the uGUI objects in the Game View that can be pressed now, with their rects in Game View coordinates, in Play Mode. Requires com.unity.ugui.

commands.name: execute
commands.description: Execute a Unity Editor menu item by its path.

commands.name: close
commands.description: Close Prefab Mode and return to the main stage.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a Prefab asset from a GameObject in the scene.

commands.name: instantiate
commands.description: Instantiate a Prefab into the current scene.

commands.name: open
commands.description: Open a Prefab asset in Prefab Mode for editing.

commands.name: select
commands.description: Select an asset in the Unity Project Window, focus the window, and ping it.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Get the list of all configured recorders and their settings. Requires com.unity.recorder.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a Movie recorder to the Movie recorder list. Requires com.unity.recorder.

options.name: --encoder
options.description: Encoder: UnityMediaEncoder (default), ProRes, GIF. (Default: @"UnityMediaEncoder")

options.name: --encoding-quality
options.description: Encoding quality (UnityMediaEncoder only): Low (default), Medium, High. (Default: @"Low")

options.name: --capture-audio
options.description: Whether to capture audio (default: false). (Optional)

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a Movie recorder by index. Use 'recorder all list' to find the index. Requires com.unity.recorder.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start recording with the specified Movie recorder. Only available in Play Mode. Requires com.unity.recorder.

options.name: --fps
options.description: Frames per second (default: 30). (Default: 30)

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop the current Movie recording and save the video file.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new empty scene and save it at the specified asset path.

commands.name: hierarchy
commands.description: Get the GameObject hierarchy of every loaded scene (or the Prefab in Prefab Mode).

commands.name: open
commands.description: Open a scene in the Unity Editor by its asset path.

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Capture the Scene View as a PNG file. Available in both Edit Mode and Play Mode, including Prefab Mode.

commands.name: focus
commands.description: Switch focus to the Scene View window.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new ScriptableObject .asset file.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List serialized properties of a ScriptableObject .asset file.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set a serialized property on a ScriptableObject .asset file.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run Unity Test Runner tests and wait for completion.

options.name: --test-mode
options.description: Test mode: "EditMode" or "PlayMode". (Default: null)

options.name: --test-names
options.description: Specific test names to run. (Default: null)

options.name: --group-names
options.description: Test group names to run. (Default: null)

options.name: --category-names
options.description: Test category names to run. (Default: null)

options.name: --assembly-names
options.description: Test assembly names to run. (Default: null)

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a default clip to a Timeline track. Undo supported. Requires com.unity.timeline.

options.name: --start
options.description: Start time of the clip in seconds. (Default: 0)

options.name: --duration
options.description: Duration of the clip in seconds. 0 uses the track's default duration. (Default: 0)

options.name: --clip-name
options.description: Optional display name for the clip. (Default: @"")

commands.name: modify
commands.description: Change the timing and settings of a Timeline clip. Only the specified values are changed. Undo supported. Requires com.unity.timeline.

options.name: --start
options.description: Start time of the clip in seconds (>= 0). (Default: null)

options.name: --duration
options.description: Duration of the clip in seconds (> 0). (Default: null)

options.name: --time-scale
options.description: Speed multiplier of the clip (> 0). (Default: null)

options.name: --clip-in
options.description: Offset in seconds into the clip's source where playback starts (>= 0). (Default: null)

options.name: --ease-in-duration
options.description: Ease in duration in seconds (>= 0). (Default: null)

options.name: --ease-out-duration
options.description: Ease out duration in seconds (>= 0). (Default: null)

options.name: --pre-extrapolation
options.description: Extrapolation before the clip (None, Hold, Loop, PingPong, Continue). (Default: null)

options.name: --post-extrapolation
options.description: Extrapolation after the clip (None, Hold, Loop, PingPong, Continue). (Default: null)

options.name: --display-name
options.description: Display name of the clip. (Default: null)

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the serialized properties of the content (PlayableAsset) of a Timeline clip as JSON. Specify either instanceId or assetPath. Requires com.unity.timeline.

options.name: --instance-id
options.description: The instanceId of a GameObject with a PlayableDirector component. 0 to use assetPath instead. (Default: 0)

options.name: --asset-path
options.description: Asset path of the TimelineAsset. Used when instanceId is 0. (Default: null)

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set a serialized property on the content (PlayableAsset) of a Timeline clip, e.g. m_Clip to assign an AnimationClip. Undo supported. Requires com.unity.timeline.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a clip from a Timeline track by index. Undo supported. Requires com.unity.timeline.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new TimelineAsset (.playable file). Requires com.unity.timeline.

commands.name: evaluate
commands.description: Evaluate a Timeline at the specified time without playing it. In Edit Mode (including Prefab Mode), the Timeline window preview is used, so animated values are reverted when the preview ends. Requires com.unity.timeline.

commands.name: play
commands.description: Start playback of a Timeline on a PlayableDirector. Requires com.unity.timeline.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop playback of a Timeline on a PlayableDirector. Requires com.unity.timeline.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a track to a TimelineAsset. Undo supported. Requires com.unity.timeline.

options.name: --track-name
options.description: Optional name for the new track. (Default: @"")

commands.name: bind
commands.description: Set the binding of a Timeline track. Undo supported. Requires com.unity.timeline.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Get the tracks and clips of a Timeline. Specify either instanceId or assetPath. Requires com.unity.timeline.

options.name: --instance-id
options.description: The instanceId of a GameObject with a PlayableDirector component. 0 to use assetPath instead. (Default: 0)

options.name: --asset-path
options.description: Asset path of the TimelineAsset (e.g. "Assets/Timelines/MyTimeline.playable"). Used when instanceId is 0. (Default: null)

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the serialized properties of a Timeline track as JSON. Specify either instanceId or assetPath. Requires com.unity.timeline.

options.name: --instance-id
options.description: The instanceId of a GameObject with a PlayableDirector component. 0 to use assetPath instead. (Default: 0)

options.name: --asset-path
options.description: Asset path of the TimelineAsset. Used when instanceId is 0. (Default: null)

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set a serialized property on a Timeline track. Undo supported. Requires com.unity.timeline.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a track from a TimelineAsset by index. Undo supported. Requires com.unity.timeline.
